target.title: refactor: extract scheduler policy
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Reduces the size and coupling of the largest ClawSweeper CLI module by moving the normal review scheduler policy out of `src/clawsweeper.ts`. The scheduling rules are stable, well-covered policy code, but they were embedded in the broad CLI file, making future scheduler and efficiency work harder to review safely.

## Why This Change Was Made

This extracts scheduler item/review types, cadence checks, priority ranking, bucket weighting, floor backfill, hot-intake ordering, and saturated-scan checks into `src/scheduler-policy.ts`. The CLI keeps the GitHub/report orchestration and imports the pure scheduler helpers, while the existing exported test helpers are re-exported from `src/clawsweeper.ts` for compatibility.

The scheduler policy test now imports the focused module directly and uses a local item factory, so it no longer loads the full CLI through `test/helpers.ts` for these pure policy checks.

## User Impact

Runtime scheduling behavior is intended to stay unchanged. Maintainers get a smaller ownership boundary for future scheduler changes, and the focused scheduler test path loads less code.

## Evidence

- `node --test test/scheduler-policy.test.ts` passed: 12 tests, 12 pass.
- `pnpm run build` passed.
- `pnpm run lint:src` passed.
- `pnpm run lint:scripts` passed.
- `$env:PNPM_BIN='C:\Users\marti\AppData\Local\Corepack\shims\pnpm.CMD'; pnpm run check` passed: 1125 tests, 1124 pass, 1 Windows POSIX-mode skip, 0 failures; coverage and format gates passed.
- Codex review loop completed with `codex review --uncommitted -c service_tier='"fast"'`: no actionable correctness issues found. The first helper attempt was blocked by local Codex service-tier config, then the same review ran successfully with the accepted `fast` service tier override.

Extraction metrics from this Windows host:

```json
{
  "src_clawsweeper_ts_delta": { "added": 23, "removed": 334, "net_lines": -311 },
  "new_src_scheduler_policy_ts_lines": 409,
  "scheduler_policy_test_median_ms": {
    "before": 185.9,
    "after": 155.0,
    "improvement_percent": 16.6,
    "runs": 7
  },
  "scheduler_policy_import_median_ms": {
    "before_full_cli_import": 66.7,
    "after_scheduler_module_import": 41.2,
    "improvement_percent": 38.2,
    "runs": 7
  }
}
```
